content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Norfolk

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high-school diploma plus five years of equivalent experience. Review PMI's full eligibility criteria to confirm you meet education and hours requirements before applying.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp, delivered by active certified practitioners. Attend instructor-led sessions on your schedule, covering all five process groups and ten knowledge areas. This formal education satisfies PMI's mandatory contact-hour requirement.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Create your PMI account and submit your official PMP application, documenting your project-management experience and education. Pay the exam fee directly to PMI. Allow time for PMI's review and approval before you schedule your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation materials, practice questions, and review sessions to reinforce course content. Schedule your proctored PMP exam through Pearson VUE. Bring valid identification and arrive early on test day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, you hold the PMP credential for three years. Earn 60 professional development units (PDUs) during each three-year renewal cycle through training, volunteering, and ongoing education. Renew your credential and PDU record with PMI before expiration.
